shellCommands.command: cat package.json && echo "--- gitignore ---" && cat .gitignore && echo "--- agent_eval ---" && ls -la __agent_eval__/ && echo "--- top-level modules ---" && ls node_modules | head -50

rm -rf /tmp/bs && BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/bs/books.json PORT=3111 node server.js > /tmp/bs.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1.2
echo "=== startup ==="; cat /tmp/bs.log
echo; echo "=== add two books ==="
LOC=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -X POST http://localhost:3111/books --data-urlencode 'title=Dune' --data-urlencode 'author=Frank Herbert' --data-urlencode 'notes=The spice must flow.')
curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3111/books --data-urlencode 'title=Piranesi' --data-urlencode 'author=Susanna Clarke'
echo "new book url: $LOC"
echo; echo "=== home page (titles/sections) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE 'Currently reading|Finished <|>Dune<|>Piranesi<|Susanna Clarke|Mark finished' | sort | uniq -c

echo "=== book detail page (shareable link, cold GET) ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3111/books/4c51d71e | grep -E '<title>|<h1>|author|spice|Added|Mark finished'
echo; echo "=== mark Dune finished ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n' -X POST http://localhost:3111/books/4c51d71e/finish --data 'from=/'
echo; echo "=== home after finishing ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE 'Nothing on the go|>Dune<|>Piranesi<|Finished [A-Z][a-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]+' | sort | uniq -c
echo; echo "=== save notes on Piranesi ==="
PID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE '/books/[a-f0-9]+' | tail -1 | cut -d/ -f3)
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'notes save -> %{redirect_url}\n' -X POST "http://localhost:3111/books/$PID/notes" --data-urlencode 'notes=Statues, tides, the House.'
curl -s "http://localhost:3111/books/$PID" | grep -oE 'Statues, tides, the House.|Notes saved'

echo "=== data file ==="; cat /tmp/bs/books.json
echo; echo "=== notes on Piranesi specifically ==="
PID=$(node -e "const d=require('/tmp/bs/books.json');console.log(d.books.find(b=>b.title==='Piranesi').id)")
echo "piranesi id: $PID"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'notes save -> %{redirect_url}\n' -X POST "http://localhost:3111/books/$PID/notes" --data-urlencode 'notes=Statues, tides, the House.'
curl -s "http://localhost:3111/books/$PID?saved=1" | grep -oE 'Statues, tides, the House.|Notes saved.'

kill %1 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5
BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/bs/books.json PORT=3112 node server.js > /tmp/bs2.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1.2
echo "=== after restart ==="; cat /tmp/bs2.log
curl -s http://localhost:3112/ | grep -oE '>Dune<|>Piranesi<|Finished [A-Z][a-z]+ [0-9]+, [0-9]+|Mark finished'
echo; echo "=== 404 ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3112/books/nosuchid
echo "=== xss check ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3112/books --data-urlencode 'title=<script>alert(1)</script>'
curl -s http://localhost:3112/ | grep -oE '<script>[^<]*|<script>alert'
kill %1 2>/dev/null; echo done
rm -rf /tmp/bs /tmp/bs.log /tmp/bs2.log; npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "=== tree ==="; git status --short; ls -R src test 2>/dev/null | head -20
